internal.title: Incident Report: flagd Service High Error Rate
internal.body: At 10:30 UTC on 2026-11-08, the flagd service triggered a high error rate alert with a 100% error rate over the last 5 minutes. Initial diagnosis rounds found no evidence supporting common fault hypotheses such as internal error injection, resource exhaustion, or dependency failures. CPU and memory metrics were normal, and no flag changes or latency increases were observed. Despite multiple diagnosis replans, no conclusive root cause was identified. The incident was escalated to the on-call engineer for further investigation. The service remains under monitoring for any changes.
